verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a live, visual Graph that maps every Object in a Channel and how they connect, with links registered into this Knowledge Graph so users can trace how ideas relate. There is no evidence of filtering the graph to a subset of interest. Hands-on reports call the graph view useless at hundreds of objects and ask for options to organize disconnected graphs, which limits its depth for researchers. Missing for 10: documented graph filtering (by type, tag, or relation), proof of usability at scale, and in-depth docs on interactive exploration controls.
